name: glyphs-mcp
description: Edit Glyphs fonts through a shared MCP App or conversation, with explicit saving and guarded recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Review and control open Glyphs fonts from ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect to Glyphs 4 for bounded reads, supported edits and native scripts. Authorized Apply requests execute after internal validation; previews wait for Run. Scripts work on unsaved fonts and preserve a pre-run recovery copy. Saving is a separate action. The same workflow works through the MCP App and conversation.
defaultPrompt: Show the Glyphs MCP server identity and open-document status.
Read an exact glyph or layer and explain the evidence.
Preview an explicit spacing change without saving.
